summary: A compact black-and-white open-source minisite with one orange accent: display sections each paired with a small pill switch (weights, Mono vs Grotesk, OpenType on/off), a toggle that morphs Space Mono into Space Grotesk through a custom transition font, a feature card grid, a sticky glyph inspector with metric lines, and a 'Use, Modify, Contribute' close linking to Google Fonts and GitHub.

instances.look: Black top bar with a white rule under it: 'Space Grotesk' left, 'About · OpenType Features · Character Set' in the middle, 'Get Space Grotesk ↓' right, all ~12px

On black, three centred lines of white Bold 'Spä©ê / Aag®Sş%! / Grøtəsk' (diacritics, ®, ©, ə and an ss02 g) at ~218px, with a row of four small labels along the bottom, '300 Light', '400 Regular', '500 Medium' and an orange pill '700 Bold' (active)
instances.ux: Click a weight label to restyle the specimen (data-weight → font-weight); the active label becomes an orange pill
instances.learn: A glyph-salad headline (accents, symbols, alternates) plus a four-pill weight switch shows character and range in one screen with almost no UI

instances.look: First a static pair split by a white vertical rule: 'Hello, World! AaBbCc 12345' in Space Mono (Colophon Foundry, 2016) on the left and in Space Grotesk (Florian Karsten, 2020) on the right; then 'Mm1—Ww / Mono Fixed / G®otësk' at ~200px with a switch 'Space Mono' (orange pill) | 'Space Grotesk'
instances.ux: The switch morphs the display text between the monospaced parent and the proportional child: a custom 'Space Grotesk Transition' variable font interpolates widths and shapes, so letters slide into their new widths
instances.learn: When a family derives from another, build a transition font between them and let one toggle animate the derivation: the M, 1 and W visibly lose their fixed widths

reconstruction.typography: Pair ~100px Space Mono / Space Grotesk Regular white; morph ~200px 'Space Grotesk Transition'; labels ~10px
reconstruction.behaviour: div[data-features=on|off] toggles a class on .transition that changes font-variation-settings of the Transition font with a CSS transition (mono ↔ grotesk)
reconstruction.content: Words chosen for width changes: Mm1—Ww, Mono Fixed, G®otësk
reconstruction.html: div.content.large-type.transition > div.text + div.switch-container > div[data-features=on]/'Space Mono', div[data-features=off]/'Space Grotesk'; div.content.columns > div.column.space-mono

instances.learn: Split the about section: tiny credits on the left, one 24px paragraph on the right, so it reads as a specimen of the text size

instances.variantDefinition: The same running text set at a descending series of labelled sizes, from a display headline down to caption size, often in several weights side by side, to show how the family reads at every size; sometimes with a light/dark switch
instances.look: A '48px' block of eight pangram lines in German, Hungarian, Czech, Filipino, Slovenian, Catalan, Irish and Italian, each cut off at the right edge; then three paragraph columns of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in German (24px), Italian (21px) and Spanish (13px), each with its size label, and the weight pill switch (300/400/500/700) at the bottom
instances.ux: The weight pills restyle all paragraphs at once; the 48px lines are static
instances.learn: Label each block with its pixel size and reuse the hero's weight switch: visitors check reading sizes and weights with one control

instances.look: 'OpenType Features' label, then three huge lines '{ABCDäbĉ} / ⅗ H₂O / 1906 1964' with every glyph changed by a feature (case brackets, ss04 B and D, fraction, subscript, tabular 1, slashed zero, oldstyle 1964) in orange and the rest white; switch 'OpenType On' (orange pill) | 'OpenType Off'
instances.ux: The switch removes all features at once, so the orange glyphs revert to their defaults in place
instances.learn: Colour only the feature-affected glyphs and give one global On/Off: the visitor sees exactly which characters change
